name: AI for Leaders: The One-Hour Briefing
description: Follow one company's AI decisions through a winter: three vendor pitches, a test on its own calls, a first pilot that worked, a chatbot that made promises nobody approved, and the plan it took to the board. Free, practical, and built around decisions you make yourself.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI for Leaders: The One-Hour Briefing

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 6 lessons in 3 modules, play the course's Decision Lab to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 20 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
